title: Cookbooks Show American Culture
summary: Америкийн хоолны номууд тухайн үеийн түүх, амьдралын хэв маягийг харуулдаг.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Dora Mekouar, Faith Pirlo · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Dora Mekouar reported this story for VOA News. Faith Pirlo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

changes: Sign-off, credit line and the Words in This Story list removed.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the text?
options: Cookbooks teach us about history and life, not only recipes
Old cookbooks had better recipes than new ones
Americans stopped buying cookbooks because of the internet
questions.explain: Эхэнд нь "the literature offers more than just recipes" гэж хэлсэн. Хоолны ном түүх, соёлыг бас харуулдаг.

questions.prompt: When was the first American cookbook published?
questions.explain: "The first, published in 1796" гэж бичсэн. Энэ нь Амелиа Симмонсын American Cookery ном.

questions.prompt: If an old cookbook has many recipes for pickles, what does that tell you?
options: People did not have refrigerators then
People did not like fresh food
The book was written for children
questions.explain: Элиас "you know that you are looking at a time without refrigeration" гэж хэлсэн. Хөргөгчгүй үед хоолоо даршилж хадгалдаг байсан.
